messages:
lina: SummitBridge reached out to co-launch their integration in the marketplace + a joint webinar. Need a tight execution plan: launch post, bench narrative, webinar ops, lead routing, and a messaging sweep. Who owns what? :wave:

raj: I can own the marketplace listing and approvals with SummitBridge. Need final hero metric and partner legal blurb.

noah: Ill take the benchmark narrative and the short methodology note. Propose we surface: p95 gen latency for 6k context, cost per 1k tokens, and an apples-to-apples comparison vs our standard baseline.

sophie: I'll run webinar logistics + registration funnel. Suggest Wed May 13 or Tue May 19. Need speaker confirmations at least 10 business days prior.

tracy: Lead routing question: do marketplace signups go to partner-ops first or straight to SDR? Recommend partner-ops for initial qual so SummitBridge can approve intros. SFDC fields: Partner_Tag__c and Lead_Source__c.

lina: For first run, agree route to partner-ops queue with 48h qual SLA. We'll add partner_tag=summitbridge and origin=marketplace_integration.

noah: Benchmark plan: run 6k seq streaming at batch sizes {1,4} and capture median/p95 and cost. I'll flag any outliers and include raw run links. Will upload by Thu EOD.

raj: SummitBridge sent brand kit and a short blurb. I'll draft the listing and tag you, Lina, for review. Also will ask them for a customer quote if they have one.

sophie: Promo plan: 2 email waves + 2 LinkedIn posts + partner amplification. Budget ask for paid LinkedIn: $900. I'll build registration page with hidden partner_tag field.

tracy: Routing JSON for Eng / SFDC admin to implement (simple):
```json
{ "partner_tag": "summitbridge", "origin": "marketplace_integration", "route_to": "partner-ops", "qual_sla_hours": "48" }
```
Map Partner_Tag__c <- partner_tag; Lead_Source__c <- origin; AssignmentRule -> partner-ops.

lina: Owners recap: marketplace listing: raj; benchmark writeup: noah; webinar ops + landing: sophie; lead routing + SFDC mapping: tracy; launch copy + social: lina.

notify-bot: Reminder: upload partner blurb and legal-approved co-brand assets by 2026-05-05 09:00 PT.

noah: Uploaded preliminary numbers. 6k runs look clean; 12k was flaky. Recommend we headline 6k numbers and add 12k as appendix with caveats.

sophie: SummitBridge PM confirmed May 13 morning PT. Locking webinar for 2026-05-13 9am PT. I'll create the shared calendar and registration page.

raj: Draft marketplace copy pushed to the shared drive. Lina please review by Tue so we can send to SummitBridge for signoff.

lina: Will review and update the tracker. If any blockers (legal or asset gaps), flag here and I'll escalate to Partnerships. Thanks all! :rocket:
